te: A Royalist army from Orkney invades mainland Scotland but is defeated by a Covenanter army.
dz: 卡尔比斯代尔之战(Battle of Carbisdale):一支来自奥尔克尼的皇家军队入侵了苏格兰本土,但被一列约克军队所击败.
de: The Battle of Carbisdale: A Royalist army from Orkney invades mainland Scotland but is defeated by a Covenanter army.
